notes.title: Build 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]A chromatic aberration effect now triggers whenever you hit an enemy. The more accurate your shot's hue, the stronger the effect. This should juice battles up a bit!
[*]The first enemy in the tutorial no longer attacks. This should help ease first-time players in.
[*]I've tweaked some letters for improved font readability.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Before, the priest wouldn't spawn in new rooms if your blessings inventory was already full. This behavior was potentially confusing, so now the priest will always spawn in new rooms.
[*]Before, when you would talk to the arcanist, pressing the right mouse button (or equivalent gamepad button) would exit the dialogue without unlocking the boon set offered to you. Now, the boon set will unlock regardless of which mouse button you press.  
[/list]
